title: 9F second-anniversary gathering outside the Legislative Assembly
reason: Outside the assigned February 2021 event-start month; the opened article dates the gathering to February 9, 2022. Its qualitative “decenas” turnout also does not establish 50 participants.
notes: Retained as an out-of-period lead, not a February 2021 event. Body read at article lines 41-68; campaign anniversary does not establish that the same action occurred in February 2021.

title: Pro-government union gathering against proposed removal of President Bukele
reason: The opened report describes around 40 attendees, below the >=50 threshold.
notes: The article was published February 11 and calls the gathering “this Wednesday,” identifying February 10. It says around 40 people came from across the country and 40 unions were represented among about 250. The union count is not an additional crowd count. The action is framed as pro-government support and opposition to an Assembly removal initiative; neither political support nor the article’s general labor-law rhetoric establishes an eligible event when the reported turnout is below threshold.
